# Datadads

> Boutique collective of senior data engineers, software developers and data scientists in Nijmegen, the Netherlands. For business clients: data and software solutions (data platforms, pipelines, custom software), AI advice, AI proofs of concept on your own data, and analytics and reporting. Sustainable value over quick wins, results over hype.
